title: Bound extreme causal pending retry orders so one damaged row cannot exhaust store-wide scheduling
outcome: An extreme numeric retry order cannot stop new original requests or healthy pending recovery, and damaged metadata retains its original bytes.
acceptance: A disposable open-store regression with an extreme integer or real retry order demonstrates that new request creation and healthy pending settlement continue without rewriting original custody or malformed metadata.
Strict boot validation and bounded private diagnostics remain consistent with the supported retry-order domain.
